notablePrerequisites:
Glistening Oil attached to Skirk Fire Marshal.
You control at least five untapped Goblins.
description:
Activate Skirk Fire Marshal by tapping five untapped Goblins, giving each opposing creature ten -1/-1 counters and giving each opponent ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten poison counters.
